item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 20/Oct/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense northeast monsoon will persist over southern China in the next few days. Tropical Cyclone Fengshen will move across the central and northern parts of the South China Sea today, gradually edging closer to the coast of Guangdong. Under the combined effect of the monsoon and Fengshen, it will be persistently windy with rain over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Temperatures will fall appreciably. Seas will be rough with swells. Under the influence of the monsoon, Fengshen will start to turn southwestwards and weaken on Tuesday. With Fengshen departing from the coast of Guangdong, the weather will be brighter and daytime temperatures will rise over the region in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 20/10 (Monday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, force 6 offshore, up to force 8 on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Bright periods during the day. A few rain patches later. Temperatures will fall appreciably at night. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 23 - 29 C
R.H. range: 50 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
